text: What seat count did Gideon land on for Vantorre Group in the July thread in #strategic-pod? He corrected himself in that thread and I want the corrected figure for the QBR deck.
reply_text:
Gideon's corrected figure is **280 seats**. He first posted 300 on July 1 in #strategic-pod, then corrected it a couple of minutes later. The 300 came from a combined staging tab that included sandbox logins from the May rollout. He said 280 is the active seat count on the production roster as of July 1. Ruth's reply in that thread asked him to make sure the Q3 QBR deck reflects the corrected roster.

I pulled this from the brain's copy of the channel. I didn't re-read the live channel, so check it there if you want the original wording.
